label: Plains
description: Wide open grassland dotted with standing stones and ancient cairns.

label: Forest
description: Dense woodland where sunlight filters through a thick canopy.

label: Swamp
description: Murky water, twisted mangroves, and half-submerged ruins.

label: Desert
description: Endless dunes interrupted by half-buried pillars and sun-bleached altars.

label: Arctic
description: A frozen expanse of ice sheets and howling wind.

label: Mountain
description: Sheer cliff faces and narrow trails between jagged peaks.

label: Underground
description: Cold stone corridors, natural caverns, and the endless dark below.

label: Urban
description: Bustling streets, guild halls, and hidden passages in a settlement.

label: Aquatic
description: Open seas, submerged ruins, and river crossings.

label: Shadowfell
description: A gloomy mirror of reality drained of colour and warmth.

label: Feywild
description: A place where colours are too vivid and logic bends.

label: Elemental Chaos
description: A roiling maelstrom where elemental forces and demonic powers collide.
